t0012-01.gloss: A courier's card sets a return after the access window.
t0012-01.rival_reading: A field-delivery schedule could run past a road restriction; the late return line does not identify who changed access.

t0012-02.gloss: A rare everyday object carries residue tied to field work before restriction.
t0012-02.rival_reading: Emergency workers crossing treated land could have picked up the same residue; the objects do not prove the farm program began the emergency.
